research_question: Does a completed one-hour Bollinger-inside-Keltner volatility squeeze followed by a directional fifteen-minute expansion and a separate five-minute continuation confirmation produce robust cost-positive day-trading opportunities?

reused: volatility compression precedes expansion but does not predict direction
direction is chosen only after a completed breakout
volume confirmation and a stop outside the compression structure
cross-market volatility state and range information are useful state variables

scenario.context: at least three consecutive completed one-hour bars with 20-hour Bollinger Bands wholly inside 20-hour Keltner Channels
scenario.liquidity_objective: the high or low of the completed six-hour compression box
scenario.interaction: a completed fifteen-minute bar closes outside that box with a large body, above-prior volume, directional taker pressure and normalized range expansion

market_state.BREADTH_SQUEEZE_RELEASE: at least three markets break in the same direction at the same completed fifteen-minute timestamp
market_state.RELATIVE_SQUEEZE_RELEASE: breadth is unresolved, but one market has a uniquely large ATR-normalized expansion

scenario.confirmation: the next completed five-minute bar remains outside the box, closes further in the breakout direction and keeps aligned taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: beyond the opposite extreme of the breakout bar and compression boundary plus ten percent of prior one-hour ATR
scenario.management: trail the best completed five-minute close by one and a half prior one-hour ATRs
scenario.arbitration: one global open position across four symbols

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: squeeze and box use completed bars; breakout is completed before confirmation; entry is after a separately completed confirmation bar

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in all declared splits advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not alter squeeze duration, channel parameters, breakout, confirmation or stop thresholds after evaluation.
